title: Approximate tangent planes are classical tangent planes of spt V for Lᵖ mean curvature (Simon 6.3)
statement: Assume ApproxTangentAE and (GF). Then ClassicalTangent holds: if n ≥ 1, U is open, V has generalized mean curvature H ∈ L^p_loc(μ_V) in U with p > n, θ ≥ 1 μ_V-a.e. in U, x ∈ U, and V.IsApproxTangentAt x P, then sup{ρ^{-1}dist(y − x, P) : y ∈ spt V ∩ B_ρ(x)} → 0 as ρ ↓ 0 (with sSup of the image set in Lean).
lean_statement: ApproxTangentAE → (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight) → ClassicalTangent
